results.question: Who were Niels Bohr's doctoral students?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name:'Niels Bohr'})-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person) RETURN s.qid, s.name

results.question: Who was Max Born's doctoral advisor?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person)-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person {name:'Max Born'}) RETURN a.qid, a.name

results.question: Which doctoral students of Arnold Sommerfeld won the Nobel Prize in Physics?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name:'Arnold Sommerfeld'})-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(w:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) RETURN DISTINCT s.qid, s.name

results.question: How many doctoral students did Arnold Sommerfeld have?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name:'Arnold Sommerfeld'})-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person) RETURN count(DISTINCT s)

results.question: Which Nobel Prize in Physics laureates had a Nobel laureate (any Nobel) as doctoral advisor?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person)-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(w:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) WHERE a.is_nobel RETURN DISTINCT s.qid, s.name

results.question: Who received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:RECEIVED]->(w:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) WHERE r.year = 1921 RETURN p.qid, p.name

results.question: How many people in the graph received the Nobel Prize in Physics?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(w:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

results.question: Which women received the Nobel Prize in Physics?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(w:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) WHERE p.gender = 'female' RETURN DISTINCT p.qid, p.name

results.question: Which physicists born in Hungary worked at an institution in the United States?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WORKED_AT]->(i:Institution) WHERE p.birth_country = 'Hungary' AND i.country = 'United States' RETURN DISTINCT p.qid, p.name

results.question: How many people worked at CERN?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WORKED_AT]->(i:Institution {name:'CERN'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

results.question: Who were J. J. Thomson's doctoral students?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name:'Joseph John Thomson'})-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person) RETURN s.qid, s.name

results.question: Who was Richard Feynman's doctoral advisor?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person)-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person {name:'Richard Feynman'}) RETURN a.qid, a.name

results.question: Who in the graph received the Fields Medal?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(w:Award {name:'Fields medal'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.qid, p.name

results.question: Who are Niels Bohr's academic grandchildren (students of his students)?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name:'Niels Bohr'})-[:ADVISED]->(:Person)-[:ADVISED]->(g:Person) RETURN DISTINCT g.qid, g.name

results.question: Which doctoral students of Enrico Fermi won a Nobel Prize?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name:'Enrico Fermi'})-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person) WHERE s.is_nobel RETURN s.qid, s.name

results.question: Who received both the Nobel Prize in Physics and the Copley Medal?
results.cypher: MATCH (w1:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'})<-[:RECEIVED]-(p:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(w2:Award {name:'Copley Medal'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.qid, p.name

results.question: How many people in the graph were born before 1700?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.birth_year < 1700 RETURN count(p)

results.question: Who received the Wolf Prize in Physics in the 1990s?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:RECEIVED]->(w:Award {name:'Wolf Prize in Physics'}) WHERE r.year >= 1990 AND r.year <= 1999 RETURN DISTINCT p.qid, p.name

results.question: Who received both the ICTP Dirac Medal and the Nobel Prize in Physics?
results.cypher: MATCH (w1:Award {name:'ICTP Dirac Medal'})<-[:RECEIVED]-(p:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(w2:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.qid, p.name

results.question: Who was Marie Curie's doctoral advisor?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person)-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person {name:'Marie Sklodowska-Curie'}) RETURN a.qid, a.name

results.question: Which of Ernest Rutherford's doctoral students won the Nobel Prize in Physics?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name:'Ernest Rutherford'})-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) RETURN DISTINCT s.qid, s.name

results.question: How many doctoral students did Max Born have?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name:'Max Born'})-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person) RETURN count(DISTINCT s)

results.question: Who was educated at the University of Cambridge and won the Nobel Prize in Physics?
results.cypher: MATCH (i:Institution {name:'University of Cambridge'})<-[:EDUCATED_AT]-(p:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.qid, p.name

results.question: Who worked at the Institute for Advanced Study?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WORKED_AT]->(i:Institution {name:'Institute for Advanced Study'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.qid, p.name

results.question: Which people working in quantum mechanics were born in Austria?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WORKS_IN]->(f:Field {name:'quantum mechanics'}) WHERE p.birth_country = 'Austria' RETURN DISTINCT p.qid, p.name

results.question: Who shared a doctoral advisor with Werner Heisenberg?
results.cypher: MATCH (h:Person {name:'Werner Heisenberg'})<-[:ADVISED]-(a:Person)-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person) WHERE s.qid <> h.qid RETURN DISTINCT s.qid, s.name

results.question: How many academic descendants does Arnold Sommerfeld have within three generations?
results.cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name:'Arnold Sommerfeld'})-[:ADVISED*1..3]->(d:Person) RETURN count(DISTINCT d)

results.question: Who is the earliest-born recipient of the Nobel Prize in Physics in the graph?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) WITH min(p.birth_year) AS y MATCH (q:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) WHERE q.birth_year = y RETURN DISTINCT q.qid, q.name

results.question: How many people received the Max Planck Medal?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(:Award {name:'Max Planck Medal'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

results.question: Which laureates of a major award were born in Japan?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.is_laureate AND p.birth_country = 'Japan' RETURN p.qid, p.name
